description_en: Creates a subtask for a data flow streaming task
description_zh: 创建数据流动流式任务的子任务
kebab_example: aliyun nas create-data-flow-sub-task --file-system-id bmcpfs-370lx1ev9ss27o00000 --data-flow-id df-194433a5be310000 --data-flow-task-id task-38aa8e890f450000 --src-file-path /test/file.png --dst-file-path /mnt/file.png --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDataFlowSubTask

parameters.help_en:
The data flow task ID.
Only data flow streaming task IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh:
数据流动任务ID。
仅支持数据流动流式任务ID
parameters.name: data_flow_task_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run for this request.

A dry run checks parameter validity and resource availability without actually creating an instance or incurring fees.

Valid values:

true: Sends a check request without creating the data flow. The check items include whether required parameters are specified, the request format, and business limit dependencies. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, HTTP status code 200 is returned, but DataFlowSubTaskId is empty.
false (default): Sends a normal request. After the check passes, the instance is directly created
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次创建请求执行预检。

预检操作会帮助您检查参数有效性、校验库存等，并不会实际创建实例，也不会产生费用。

取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建数据流动。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制依赖条件。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回200 HttpCode，但DataFlowSubTaskId为空。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性，从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html。

若用户未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
